# MyAiBank
> AI-powered personal finance platform for Australians.

## What it does
MyAiBank connects to Australian bank accounts via Open Banking and uses AI to automatically track spending, categorise transactions, detect subscriptions, forecast cash flow, and score financial health.

## Core features
- Bank account aggregation via Open Banking (Fiskil)
- Automatic transaction categorisation
- AI-powered spending insights
- Cash flow forecasting
- Subscription detection
- Financial health scoring
- Budget tracking
- Portfolio tracking

## Pricing
- $14.99 AUD per month
- Free trial available

## Target audience
Australians who want to understand and improve their finances — budgeting, saving, debt reduction, investment tracking

Website: https://myaibank.ai
